title: LQ Digital Mode Family — Message Encoding & Decoding Golden Vectors Suite
author: Luis Quesada (HB9IPH) <luis@lq8.org>
description: Comprehensive golden test vector suite for message parsing, canonical formatting, 77-bit Huffman payload serialization, CRC-14 error detection, and LDPC(174,91) forward error correction codeword generation.
